parsed.internal_thinking: Sean is offering 2 Wheat for my 1 Ore. I currently have 1 Ore and 2 Wheat. Sean has a massive surplus of Wheat (5) and already has 2 Ore, meaning this trade likely gives him the 3rd Ore he needs to build a City (3 Ore, 2 Wheat). Accepting this would directly fuel his lead while I only gain Wheat, which I already have and can't use for much without Ore or Brick. Furthermore, I've been building a narrative with Hadar that Sean is hoarding resources and playing selfishly; accepting a deal from him now would undermine my credibility and help the person we are both trying to suppress. I will reject and keep the Ore for my own future City or Dev card.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Sean's 2 Wheat for 1 Ore. He is likely one Ore away from a City. I must keep my Ore to prevent him from pulling ahead and to maintain my alliance with Hadar.
parsed.say_outloud: שון, אתה באמת מנסה להוציא ממני את האבן האחרונה שלי בשביל עוד חיטה שגם ככה יש לך בשפע? הדר, את רואה? הוא פשוט מנסה להשלים לעיר בזמן שהוא מספר לנו סיפורים על איזון. אני לא מחזק אותך ככה.
